wikidebates-debate-text-self-eval-blurb:
Are you more “pro” or “con”? Assess yourself!

You can browse this debate by answering, for each argument, two questions:

  1. Is this argument well-founded?
  2. Is this argument important to you?

You’ll get your “pro/con” percentage and an analysis of your stance.

wikidebates-debate-banners-debate-fancif: This debate is considered [[:Category:Fanciful debates|fanciful]]. Its presence in the public space is not obvious.

Please provide quotes to the [[Talk:$1|talk page]] showing that conflicting opinions are held on the matter.
Reminder: according to the [[Wikidebates:Founding Principles|founding principles]], an argument has its place on Wikidebates only insofar as its presence can be attested in the public space.
wikidebates-debate-banners-debate-sensit: This debate is [[:Category:Sensitive debates|sensitive]]. Arguments relayed on this page may shock.

Reminder: these arguments are only relayed insofar as their presence can be attested in the public space. They are endorsed neither by the editors of the site, nor by the [[Wikidebates:Laboratory of Methodical Debate|association]] which administers Wikidebates.
